title: Full-output classical simulation of lossy boson sampling with single-photon and equal-squeezing inputs
status: internally checked research notes; directly overlapping prior work acknowledged; independent expert review pending

main_claims.fock: Original-scope full-output Haar-average theorem; same guarantee covered by Lim 2611.01434v1, Theorem 1.
main_claims.gaussian: Every mode equally squeezed; fixed rational zeta and eta; full output; Haar-average TV; same guarantee covered by Lim Theorem 2.
main_claims.exchangeable: Geometric survival moments mu_l<=gamma^l for fixed gamma<1; rational polynomial-bit count thresholds. Includes uniformly selected fixed survivor count k<=gamma*n. Consequence of the conditional-sector estimate.
main_claims.nonuniform_input: Independent rational eta_i<=gamma<1 with profile independent of U; one prefilter and one uniform sampler call. Reduction already explicit in Lim Appendix F.2.
main_claims.sharper_purity: Weighted unprojected reduced purity bounded by eta_max^l; no l+1 factor. Convexity consequence, no separate novelty claim.
main_claims.finite_precision: Worst-case polynomial bit analysis retained; exchangeable categorical and prefilter random-bit budgets explicit.
main_claims.novelty: Previous no-equivalent-theorem assessment withdrawn. Main guarantees and thinning reduction known-covered; other formulations retained without priority claims.

clean_archive_replay.limits: Internal finite checks and data replay; not independent expert verification, an all-size proof certificate or a practical sampler benchmark.

source_comparison: SOURCE-COMPARISON.md inside supplement; direct overlap and correction checked 3 November 2026
version_history: 2.0 and 1.x assets preserved. Previous no-equivalent-theorem conclusion superseded. 2.1 adds loss-model consequences and corrected attribution.
